ideas.pitch: A tool that generates zero-knowledge proofs of membership in Bitshala cohorts or Bitcoin developer groups and publishes them over Nostr relays without revealing the user's real pubkey or identity.
ideas.title: Nostr-Gated ZK Credential Bridge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets both the Privacy and Nostr tracks by combining censorship-resistant communication with advanced ZK proofs, mirroring winning patterns from ZK and privacy hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An AI agent that autonomously negotiates and pays for API access or premium data feeds using Lightning Network LND invoices, entirely coordinated via Nostr direct messages.
ideas.title: SatsAgent: Autonomous Lightning Micropayment Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings AI directly into the Bitcoin and Nostr stack as requested by the AI boss fight, fulfilling the hard engineering and sponsor alignment patterns.

ideas.pitch: A reusable client-side library that enables silent payments on Bitcoin, allowing users to receive funds repeatedly to a single static address without on-chain linkage, broadcasted via Nostr notifications.
ideas.title: SilentPay Nostr Integration
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves real-world Bitcoin surveillance issues and leans heavily into Bitshala's focus on deep Bitcoin protocol stacks and privacy tooling.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized fact-checking and timestamping tool that anchors document hashes onto Bitcoin transactions while publishing the cryptographic proof chain strictly through Nostr event kinds.
ideas.title: Nostr Snort-Proof Document Attestation
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines censorship resistance with immutable proof tracking, matching winning patterns from security and blockchain attestation hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight AI agent runner fine-tuned on Bitcoin Core PRs and Miniscript specifications that reviews Bitcoin script pull requests locally for security and efficiency vulnerabilities.
ideas.title: BitLLM: Local AI Code Reviewer for Bitcoin Scripts
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses Bitshala's mission of building Bitcoin Open Source Software by creating actionable developer tooling for the ecosystem.
